guides.label: LotteryCorner Guide

items.title: Why Midday and Evening results can show different dates
items.summary: Midday and Evening are separate Florida games with separate drawings. If today’s later drawing has not happened or has not been published, LotteryCorner continues to show the most recent completed result for that member game.
takeaways: Each member game keeps its own result date.
Rows remain in a familiar order.
A pending draw does not erase the last completed result.

destination.note: The full guide opens on LotteryCorner once the guide page is live. It also covers what happens when a drawing is delayed.

items.title: What Fireball means in Florida Pick games
items.summary: Fireball is a separately drawn add-on used with eligible Pick plays. It may replace one of the main Pick numbers for prize matching, but it is not an extra ordinary winning ball.
takeaways: It applies only when the ticket includes the add-on.
Ticket play type and amount still matter.

destination.note: The full guide opens on LotteryCorner once the guide page is live. It walks through each Pick play type with the add-on.

items.title: Powerball, Double Play, and Power Play explained
items.summary: The main Powerball result, Double Play result, and Power Play multiplier have different roles. LotteryCorner displays them separately so players can see which numbers and options apply to their ticket.
takeaways: Double Play is a separate secondary drawing.
Power Play is an optional multiplier for eligible purchases.

destination.note: The full guide opens on LotteryCorner once the guide page is live. The Powerball result it refers to, including Double Play, is at the top of this page.
